name: Cold Introduction
description: First-touch email to a coach who has never heard of you. Short, specific, includes film and key metric.
subject: {{classYear}} {{position}} {{firstName}} {{lastName}} | {{club}}
recommendedTiming: Send during evaluation or contact periods. Avoid dead periods.

name: Tournament / Showcase Invite
description: Send 10-14 days before a major event the coach is likely attending.
subject: {{firstName}} {{lastName}} ({{position}} | {{club}}) - playing at {{tournamentName}}
recommendedTiming: 10-14 days before the event. Always include court, time, and jersey #.

name: Follow-up After No Response
description: Send 10-14 days after the initial cold email if there's been no reply.
subject: Following up | {{firstName}} {{lastName}} {{classYear}} {{position}}
recommendedTiming: 10-14 days after first email. Don't follow up more than twice without a response.

name: Post-Event Recap
description: Send within 48 hours of an event a coach attended or might have attended.
subject: {{firstName}} {{lastName}} | {{tournamentName}} recap
recommendedTiming: Within 48 hours of the event closing.
